# Traefik — root-context-sse

App at /, proxy at /, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. Traefik has no way to omit upgrade support, so the refusal is explicit: a headers middleware strips the client's Upgrade and Connection headers before the request reaches the backend.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Traefik dynamic config (`vaadin.yml`), mounted into
`/etc/traefik/dynamic`:

```yaml
# App at /, proxy at /, PUSH over Server-Sent Events through a proxy that
# cannot upgrade a connection.
#
# The Apache and NGINX *-sse configs achieve that by omission — no
# `upgrade=websocket`, no Upgrade/Connection headers. Traefik has no such
# omission available: every router upgrades when the client asks, so the
# refusal has to be explicit. The no-websocket middleware below strips the
# client's upgrade intent before the request reaches the backend, which is the
# closest equivalent to a proxy that was never taught to upgrade.
#
# SSE still works, because it is an ordinary HTTP GET that streams
# text/event-stream, and the client-to-server messages are XHR POSTs to the
# same path. Selecting a WebSocket transport here fails, which is the point of
# the scenario rather than a bug.
http:
  routers:
    vaadin:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      middlewares:
        - no-websocket
        - compress
      service: vaadin

  services:
    vaadin:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://vaadin:8080

  middlewares:
    # An empty value removes the header rather than setting it empty.
    no-websocket:
      headers:
        customRequestHeaders:
          Upgrade: ""
          Connection: ""

    # See root-context/vaadin.yml: this denylist is what keeps the event stream
    # out of the compressor, and it is load-bearing for every *-sse scenario.
    compress:
      compress:
        excludedContentTypes:
          - text/event-stream
          - text/plain
```

The entryPoints and the file provider come from the shared
[traefik.yml](../../traefik.yml), mounted read-only.
